bandReport.notes: Items 84-100, no gaps. Page layout: p18 = 84,85 | 86,87; p19 = 88,89,90 | 91,92; p20 = 93,94 | 95,96; p21 = 97,98 | 99,100. Item 84 begins at the top of p18 column 1 (nothing carries over from p17, which belongs to another agent), and item 100 ends complete on p21 with the paper's last item, so firstComplete and lastComplete are both true. COLUMN CROPS: no slicing on any of the four pages, and every page was cross-checked against pNN.png after reading c1 then c2. Each crop pair overlaps slightly into its neighbour, which is expected and harmless: p18-c1 and p19-c1 catch the NEXT column's item numbers (86./87. and 91./92.) at their right edge, and p21-c2 catches a sliver of column 1's line-END letters at its left edge. In every case the crop contains its own item numbers and its own complete lines, so no text was attributed across the gutter. Page 21 carries the narrowest gutter in the band (gutterX 826, width 30 per _render.json) and was inspected with particular care; it is clean, and its sparse right column (99, 100) split correctly. PRINTED DEFECTS, both transcribed verbatim per the brief and also recorded in the affected question's flags: (1) Q84 option (d) - the first character is set as a lowercase letter 'l', not the digit '1'. Verified at 12x zoom against the digit '1' in options (a) and (c) of the same question: the digit has a triangular top-left flag and a wide two-sided base serif, this glyph has neither and is a taller, thinner stem. Transcribed as the digit '1', which is unmistakably the intended reading and keeps the option usable. (2) Q96 statement 2 ends 'the merger of associate banks with the parent State Bank of India has been affected' - the booklet prints 'affected' where 'effected' is standard usage. Verified at 6x zoom, transcribed as printed, NOT corrected. Q97 option (c) carries a small ink speck above the digit '4'; checked at 6x zoom and it is scan noise, the digit is a plain '4' and the option reads '1, 2 and 4 only'. No missing, duplicated or unreadable items, no identical option pairs. SOFT SUBTOPICS not present in catalog.json (subject and chapter are copied exactly from it in every case): Q86 'Invasive Alien Species' and Q91 'Post-Independence India'. Q91 also needed a judgement call on chapter - it is a chronology of four POST-1947 events, and History in catalog.json has no post-independence chapter, so it is filed under 'Miscellaneous Historical Areas', that subject's explicit catch-all, rather than under 'Modern India and the Freedom Struggle', which the events postdate.
